The *Dutiyasīsappacālaka* is the twentieth training rule in the *Sekhiya* section of the Pali *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* within the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule concerns monastic deportment, specifically proscribing swaying or shaking the head while moving or sitting in inhabited areas. An English translation is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali. None of the sampled secondary literature passages address this Vinaya text; all retrieved references citing "SK 20" pertain to verse 20 of the philosophical treatise *Sāṃkhyakārikā*.
